description:
Other lines for Flood, Cabo Verde, 12 August 2025 (FL20250812CPV): 524 features merged from 17 source layers. Lines layers that match none of the named groups. The source layer names below say what each holds. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Deteção de danos no património cultural através da análise de imagem de satélite de 16 de Agosto de 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/detecao-de-danos-no-patrimonio-cultural-atraves-da-analise-de-imagem-de-satelite-de-16-de-)
- [Flood impact assessment  in Sao Vicente Island, Cabo Verde (13 to 16 August 2025)](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-impact-assessment-in-sao-vicente-island-cabo-verde-13-to-16-august-2025)
- [Flood impact assessment in East Sao Vicente Municipality, Cabo Verde as of 14 August 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-impact-assessment-in-east-sao-vicente-municipality-cabo-verde-as-of-14-august-2025)
- [Flood impact assessment in Mindelo City, Sao Vicente Municipality, Cabo Verde  as of 13 August 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-impact-assessment-in-mindelo-city-sao-vicente-municipality-cabo-verde-as-of-13-augus)
- [Flood impact assessment in Porto Novo Town, Porto Novo Municipality, Cabo Verde as of 13 August 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-impact-assessment-in-porto-novo-town-porto-novo-municipality-cabo-verde-as-of-13-aug)
- [Preliminary Satellite-derived Flood Impact Assessment, North Santo Antao Island, Cabo Verde](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/preliminary-satellite-derived-flood-impact-assessment-north-santo-antao-island-cabo-verde)
- [Satellite-detected damage to cultural heritage in the area of Cova, Ribeira Paúl and Torre Natural Park, Santo Antão, Cabo Verde, as of 16 August 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-to-cultural-heritage-in-the-area-of-cova-ribeira-paul-and-torre-natural-park-santo-)
- [UNOSAT Live web map - Home Layers Share UN-ASIGN Flash flood in Cabo Verde](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/unosat-live-web-map-home-layers-share-un-asign-flash-flood-in-cabo-verde)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Exs
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Definite; 2 = Doubtful. The decoded text is in `Exs_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: FClass
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Highway; 2 = Primary; 3 = Secondary; 4 = Tertiary; 5 = Local/ Urban; 6 = Trail; 7 = Private. The decoded text is in `FClass_label`.

table:columns.name: SrfTpe
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Paved; 2 = Gravel; 3 = Dirt/Sand; 4 = Steel; 5 = Wood; 6 = Grass. The decoded text is in `SrfTpe_label`.

table:columns.name: SrfCond
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Rough (<40kph); 2 = Smooth (>40kph); 3 = Snow/Ice; 4 = Mud. The decoded text is in `SrfCond_label`.

table:columns.name: SrfPrep
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Natural Compaction; 2 = Traffic Compaction; 3 = Engineered Compaction; 4 = Uncompacted. The decoded text is in `SrfPrep_label`.

table:columns.name: IsSeasonal
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Yes; 2 = No. The decoded text is in `IsSeasonal_label`.

table:columns.name: CurntPrac
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Non-motorized; 2 = Motorbike; 3 = 4WD < 3.5MT; 4 = Light truck < 10MT; 5 = Heavy truck < 20MT; 6 = Truck + Trailer > 20MT. The decoded text is in `CurntPrac_label`.

table:columns.name: GdWthrPrac
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Non-motorized; 2 = Motorbike; 3 = 4WD < 3.5MT; 4 = Light truck < 10MT; 5 = Heavy truck < 20MT; 6 = Truck + Trailer > 20MT. The decoded text is in `GdWthrPrac_label`.

table:columns.name: BdWthrPrac
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Non-motorized; 2 = Motorbike; 3 = 4WD < 3.5MT; 4 = Light truck < 10MT; 5 = Heavy truck < 20MT; 6 = Truck + Trailer > 20MT. The decoded text is in `BdWthrPrac_label`.

table:columns.name: IsUndrCstr
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Yes; 2 = No. The decoded text is in `IsUndrCstr_label`.

table:columns.name: Sec
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Category A: low risk; 2 = Category B: low to medium risk; 3 = Category C: medium to high risk; 4 = Category D: high risk; 5 = Category E: critical risk. The decoded text is in `Sec_label`.

table:columns.name: OpStatus
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Open; 2 = Restricted; 3 = Closed; 4 = Abandonned/Disused. The decoded text is in `OpStatus_label`.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 11 = EB; 22 = WP; 33 = LB; 44 = JL; 55 = VG; 66 = CJ; 77 = LD; 88 = HK; 99 = ER; 100 = KM; 111 = MFB; 777 = SB; 1000 = Unknown. The decoded text is in `StaffID_label`.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: BdWthrPrac_label
table:columns.description: `BdWthrPrac` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.
